**Status:** Operational framework.
**Owner:** BNR Lead and BNR Developer.

## Purpose

Maintain enough evidence and current guidance for another authorised operator to understand, reproduce and safely continue routine work.

## Records to maintain

| Record | Authoritative location |
|---|---|
| Registry records and corrections | REDCap and its audit trail |
| Protected extracts, logs, staging and review files | private BNR workspace |
| Approved public packages | `outputs/public/` |
| Website mirror and documentation | public Info-Hub repository |
| Code and documentation history | Git repository |
| Credentials, private locations and recovery contacts | private local configuration sheet |
| Material post-handover changes | concise change history |

## Routine maintenance

- keep role assignments and the private configuration sheet current;
- test that an authorised second operator can locate and run each routine pathway;
- keep Technical Manual commands aligned with current files and dialogs;
- remove obsolete navigation rather than leaving empty public pages;
- review dependencies before upgrading Stata, Quarto, Python or extensions;
- retain approved packages separately from disposable website mirrors; and
- use Git history for ordinary development changes.

## Handover checklist

The outgoing and incoming operators should jointly confirm:

- access has been granted through normal institutional routes;
- local paths and credentials are held by the correct roles;
- the latest complete release and any work in progress are identified;
- all unresolved queries, failed runs and pending approvals are listed;
- a routine workflow can be run in a safe test or current cycle;
- backup and recovery responsibilities are understood;
- repository branch and Git status are understood; and
- private access is removed when no longer required.

## Change control after formal handover

Record changes that materially affect a metric definition, approval or publication pathway, public output structure, disclosure control, required dependency or staff responsibility. Routine edits need only clear Git history.

## Annual or role-change review

Review this manual, the Technical Manual, role assignments, private configuration sheet, dependencies, access rights and recovery arrangements at least annually and whenever a key operator leaves or a core system changes.

::: {.callout-warning title="BNR confirmation required"}
Confirm retention periods, backup owner, recovery-test frequency, formal handover approver and the location of the private configuration sheet. Do not publish live access details.
:::
